title: machaeranthera johnstonii
intro: Machaeranthera johnstonii, commonly known as Johnston's greasewood, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, as well as its potential to alleviate symptoms associated with fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Johnston's greasewood include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, making it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal remedies.
